services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Set sail on a scenic lighthouse cruise and experience the beauty, history, and maritime charm of New York Harbor. Enjoy breathtaking views of iconic lighthouses throughout the region while learning about their rich history and significance from engaging guest speakers and local experts. Along the way, take in unforgettable sights of the Statue of Liberty, the stunning New York City Skyline, and the surrounding waterfront landscapes. This relaxing and educational boat tour offers the perfect blend of sightseeing, storytelling, and harbor views for guests of all ages. All Tours are scheduled for the scheduled time, however, tides and currents may increase the time needed to return to dock!

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Alfred La Banca was born in New York City in 1930. His family spent summers in New Dorp, Staten Island, and so began his love for coastal communities. He owned three IOR-rated sailboats and competed from Maine to Florida - including Newport, Annapolis, Fort Lauderdale and Key West. Lighthouses were his passion. He called them the “Vanishing Castles of America”. Sadly, these beautiful marine castles are disappearing, often abandoned or destroyed. It was the hope of Alfred LaBanca to rekindle America’s passion with lighthouses through his beautiful watercolor paintings. blurb: Located on the former site of the United States Lighthouse Service’s (USLHS) General Depot in St. George, Staten Island, the National Lighthouse Museum educates visitors about the history and technology of the nation’s lighthouses.
